license_note: Inherits AGPL-3.0 from Ultralytics YOLOv8 base weights; trained-weight redistribution constraints documented in DATASETS.md. License field reflects the post-training state, not the recipe.
weights_blocker: Three blockers: (1) FASDD/FLAME-2/D-Fire all require manual auth-walled downloads (Science Data Bank account, IEEE DataPort account, GitHub-OneDrive interactive link); (2) ultralytics + torch are not installed in the host /usr/local/bin/python3 environment; (3) no GPU/MPS-equipped Python environment is available in the agent sandbox. The training recipe at train_recipe.yaml is end-to-end runnable the moment the user provides datasets + an ultralytics environment.
notes: Second registered model. Existence trips the archetype gate (models>=2 AND signals>=100) flipping comparable_multiples archetype to computer-vision-defense. v0.1.0 is TRAINING_READY rather than RELEASED: the artifact (recipe + harness + entrypoint) is shipped, but the trained weights are pending dataset access. No fake metrics — eval.json explicitly carries status=not_yet_trained.
